say:1:1330605001:1.text: We went there to pray, but an acolyte at the gate told us the temple was closed for renovations.
say:1:1330605001:1.source_cn: 是的，我们本来打算去大山大教堂祷告。可刚到大门，门口的...
say:1:1330605001:1.male: We went there to pray, but an acolyte at the gate told us the temple was closed for renovations.
say:1:1330605001:1.female: We went there to pray, but an acolyte at the gate told us the temple was closed for renovations.

say:2:1330605002:1.text: Are you heading to the temple too? Don't waste your time going any further.
say:2:1330605002:1.source_cn: 你也打算去白山大教堂？那现在调转方向，还能少走些路。
